Card Q&A.a: 1 black level 5 or lower Digimon card or 1 red level 5 or lower Digimon card.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be played using this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)

[When Digivolving] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck for each Digimon your opponent has in play. You may play 1 black or red Digimon card with a level of 5 or less among them without paying its memory cost. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
